details: Testingflow3@1.0.0 is a dependency-confusion carrier package with no functional code. Its only content is a dependency declaration pointing to an external URL (hxxps://artifacts[.]stg[.]yosiroute[.]com/npm/lookup-codec-locale-atomic) instead of the npm registry. When installed, npm fetches the tarball from this external staging server, which is outside npm's control. The dependency name lookup-codec-locale-atomic mimics a legitimate utility package name. The package has no repository, no lifecycle hooks, and its index.js merely exports a name and version string — the external URL dependency is its sole purpose.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
